preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
preconditions.description: If root is not None, all nodes in the tree must be valid TreeNode instances with left and right attributes.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None or isinstance(return_value, TreeNode)
postconditions.description: The function returns either None (if the tree is empty) or the head of the constructed DLL (a TreeNode).

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value]) if return_value else True
postconditions.description: The returned DLL is a valid doubly linked list where each node's left and right pointers act as prev and next pointers, respectively. All nodes in the DLL are original leaf nodes of the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value]) if return_value else True and all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value]) if return_value else True
postconditions.description: The original tree is modified in-place such that all leaf nodes are removed and their left/right pointers are repurposed to form the DLL. Non-leaf nodes retain their original structure.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value]) if return_value else True and all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value]) if return_value else True
postconditions.description: The DLL starts from the leftmost leaf node of the original tree and proceeds to the rightmost leaf node, with each node's right pointer pointing to the next leaf and left pointer pointing to the previous leaf.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value]) if return_value else True and all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if return_value]) if return_value else True
postconditions.description: The modified tree's inorder traversal excludes all leaf nodes that were converted into the DLL.
